label: Yandex Reverse Image Search API
title: Yandex Reverse Image Search API: Upload, OCR & Tags
metaDescription: Find where an image appears online with Yandex: paste a link or upload a file to get matching pages, similar images, other sizes, OCR text and tags.
intro: Search Yandex by picture instead of keywords: paste an image link or upload a file and get the pages where it appears, visually similar images, other resolutions, the text read from the picture and descriptive tags, in all Yandex regions.
useCases: Find copies of your images across the web
Locate a higher-resolution version of a picture
Read the text in many images at once (OCR)

faq.q: Why use Yandex for reverse image search?
faq.a: Yandex is often better than Google or Bing at finding faces, places and older or cropped copies of a picture, so it is the usual second check for image provenance.

faq.q: Can I find where my images are used?
faq.a: Yes. "Matching pages" lists the sites showing your picture, with title, source and link; duplicates of the same page are merged and counted.

faq.q: Can I search several Yandex regions?
faq.a: Yes. Pick regions such as yandex.com and yandex.com.tr; each can return different matches.

faq.q: Does it read text in the picture?
faq.a: Yes, text recognised in the image can be returned, which helps with screenshots in bulk. Shopping matches, barcodes and detected objects are empty for most pictures.

faq.q: Do I need a Yandex account or API key?
faq.a: No. Paste an image link; no account or key.

officialApi: Yandex has no public reverse image search API. This actor returns the matches Yandex's image search shows for a picture.
